title: Rav Chana bar Hinda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: So it is cited in [the She’iltot, Miketz](https://www.sefaria.org/Sheiltot_d'Rav_Achai_Gaon.29.1): he said in the name of Rabbi Pedat, in the name of Rabbi Yochanan, “Whoever sees a dream and is troubled should set it out before three.” The reading Hyman uses, cited as Bekhorot 55b, is Rav Huna bar Ami. The supplied notice ends “and so it cites there [1].”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman prints Bekhorot 55b. The matching Bavli passage is [Berakhot 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.55b.7), with Rav Huna bar Ami speaking in Rabbi Pedat’s name, in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. The Bavli first gives “have it interpreted” (יפתרנו), then “have it ameliorated” (יטיבנו). Hyman’s text gives יפרטנו, “set it out.”

In [Hyman’s printed page, vol. II, p. 464](https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/%D7%A2%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%93:Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._II._1910.pdf/47), “and so it cites there” precedes the separate heading Rav Chana bar Chimi. The linked She’iltot gives the dream teaching under Chana bar Hinda and the teaching about Torah or the Shema before sleep under Chana bar Chimi. In the parallel at [Berakhot 14a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.14a.19), Rav Acha son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba quotes Rabbi Chiyya in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. The supplied [1] is an editorial marker in the digital transcription.
